item.title: Proxmox Server Upgrade: Solving Case and Heat Sink Issues
item.description: Encountering issues while upgrading your Proxmox server to a 1U rack mount case? Discover the challenges with motherboard stand-offs and heat sink compatibility, and learn how to address them effectively.

item.title: Upgrading Proxmox with 4x 500GB SSDs and ZFS
item.description: Integrate four 500GB SSDs into your Proxmox server with a ZFS setup. Learn about the striped and mirrored configuration for nearly 1TB of storage and get ready for a video tutorial on migrating to a 1U rackmount case.
